mapAerialSources: The aerial photographs are off until you switch them on (map → Layers). Then they are loaded straight from the servers of their sources – EOX (Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016) and the land surveys of the German states: those servers learn your IP address and which area is shown.

news.2_0_0.regions: One map for every region: zoom out on the big map (M, the mini map or the map button) and all 308 regions of Europe appear on the outlines of the countries. Zoom into one to see its roads and towns, tap a road and press "Put the car here" – the game opens that map and starts you there. Every region was opened and checked; Köln now has its ground.
news.2_0_0.map: The big map reads like a map app: a light style beside the dark one, the whole road network and every town name at every zoom, and a search that finds every town and street of the map – and any place at all through the online search (Photon, OpenStreetMap; it can be switched off in the layers).
news.2_0_0.aerial: Aerial photographs for the whole of Germany from the open data of 14 federal states, and Sentinel-2 satellite pictures for all of Europe – switch them on in the map's layers (off by default: the image servers learn which area you look at).
news.2_0_0.later: Not yet in 2.0: the theory lessons and the theory exam, weather and seasons, trams and buses by timetable, roadworks and level crossings, the forklift and the practice-yard drills, replays, cyclists and emergency vehicles, water and fuel, getting out and walking. They come back in 2.1 – until then 1.7.7 keeps them all at its own address.
news.2_0_0.intro: Fahrsim 2.0 is rewritten from the ground up in C++ (running as WebAssembly in the browser): the same roads, rules, traffic, lessons, autopilot, vehicles and languages on a new engine that needs about half the work of 1.7.7 for each picture. New in 2.0:
news.2_1_0.walk: Getting out and walking: on foot round the car and through the town, opening the doors, the bonnet and the boot; putting a car down anywhere on the map and getting into it. "On foot" is also a vehicle of its own among the traffic, with the rules for pedestrians.
news.2_1_0.weather: Weather and seasons: the real weather or a chosen one – rain, snow and fog, wet roads with less grip, wipers and washer, the season on the land and the trees, wheel tracks in the snow, and signs that apply "when wet".
news.2_1_0.transit: Trams and buses run by their timetables and stop at their stops, and the big map shows their departures. A tram to drive yourself (doors, pantograph, switches) and a lesson on a bus line.
news.2_1_0.roads: Roadworks and demonstrations, narrowed roads, level crossings with barriers, lights, bells and trains, and signs that apply only at certain times (22–6 h, Mon–Fri).
news.2_1_0.traffic: Cyclists in the traffic; emergency vehicles with blue lights and sirens – make way and form the emergency corridor; deer and wild boar at dusk.
news.2_1_0.fuel: A tank and its gauge – and running dry; petrol stations with pumps and today's prices (with a Tankerkönig key); the car wash and dirt on the car. Driving through water wets the brakes and can stall the engine.
news.2_1_0.learn: Lessons and theory: the forklift and the practice-yard drills of class B, headlights and main beam by the rules of § 17; the theory exam (30 questions, 45 minutes), the sign trainer, "spot the danger", the lesson log and theory lessons in 3D.
news.2_1_0.watch: Replays after a drive; watching any vehicle and taking over a tram or a bus; the test place with every model; and a new main menu with the vehicle on stage.
news.2_1_0.regions: Many more German towns as regions: Paderborn and hundreds more – the build of all of Germany goes on.
news.2_1_0.sdl: Experimental: a desktop version built with SDL3 and an Android app – both start straight into a drive, without the menus yet.
news.2_1_0.intro: Fahrsim 2.1 brings everything 2.0 did not have yet onto the new engine – and more besides. New in 2.1:
news.2_1_1.mirrors: Looking into the vehicle's mirrors large: the mirror key or the round button goes from the left mirror to the right one and on to the inside one, a tap on a mirror opens it, and the × or a second tap closes the panel again.
news.2_1_1.inside: The inside rear-view mirror can be put where the player wants it: dragged along the top of the picture, made larger or smaller by its grip – or left as the glass in the car.
news.2_1_1.timers: How long a light still shows what it shows, and what comes after it: a small clock over every head, the pedestrians' lights included, and none over a light that is out of order.
news.2_1_1.queues: What the queues in the traffic say: how long a queue is, how many cars stand in it and how long the last of them has been waiting – written over the cars themselves.
news.2_1_1.intro: Fahrsim 2.1.1 brings onto the new engine what was still missing from the driving picture: every mirror, and what the traffic says about itself. New in 2.1.1:
